The initially authored with-skill Grifon plan also selected the wrong logo. The higher current rubric coverage results from review-driven correction, not a demonstrated advantage from skill loading.
Baseline was exposed to prompts and expectations, but did not read the candidate. With-skill author had candidate, rubric and inherited task context.
One authored output per task/configuration; no repetitions or controlled experiment. Standard deviation reflects differences across three distinct prompts, not repeatability.
The baseline trigger file is a semantic simulation; no live trigger test is included.
Candidate install patch is unapplied. Separate candidate isolated check reportedly found 32 skills and 0 errors; see candidate-static-check.json for the actual recorded evidence.
